mapper.select: /* 반려동물 목록 조회 */ SELECT P.PET_SN , P.PET_NM , P.PET_SE_CD , P.VRTY_SN , V.VRTY_NM , P.VRTY_DRCT_INPT_NM , P.PET_GNDR_CD , P.PET_BRDT , P.PET_BDWG , P.COLR_CD , P.COLR_DRCT_INPT_NM , P.CHIP_NO , P.CHRC_CN , P.ALGY_CN , P.DSS_CN , R.BRUP_ROLE_CD , CASE WHEN R.RPRS_PET_YN = 'Y' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS RPRS_PET_YN , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BRUP_REL CR WHERE CR.PET_SN = P.PET_SN AND CR.USE_YN = 'Y' AND CR.BRUP_ROLE_CD = #{coParentRoleCd}) AS CAREGIVER_COUNT , CASE WHEN C.BSC_CHAR_SBST_YN = 'Y' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS BSC_CHAR_SBST_YN FROM BRUP_REL R JOIN PET P ON P.PET_SN = R.PET_SN AND P.DEL_YN = 'N' LEFT JOIN VRTY V ON V.VRTY_SN = P.VRTY_SN LEFT JOIN PIXEL_CHAR C ON C.PET_SN = P.PET_SN AND C.DEL_YN = 'N' WHERE R.MBR_SN = #{mbrSn} AND R.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY R.REG_DT , R.BRUP_REL_SN

/* 반려동물 단건 조회 */ SELECT PET_SN , VRTY_SN , PET_SE_CD , PET_GNDR_CD , COLR_CD , PET_NM , VRTY_DRCT_INPT_NM , COLR_DRCT_INPT_NM , CHIP_NO , CHRC_CN , ALGY_CN , DSS_CN , PET_BRDT , PET_BDWG , GOAL_BDWG , MIN_BDWG , MAX_BDWG , MIN_MEAL_QTY , MAX_MEAL_QTY , MIN_WATR_QTY , MAX_WATR_QTY , NUTR_YN , DEL_YN , REG_DT , MDFCN_DT , RGTR_ID , MDFR_ID FROM PET WHERE PET_SN = #{petSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N'

/* 사용 중인 양육 관계 조회 */ SELECT BRUP_REL_SN , PET_SN , MBR_SN , BRUP_ROLE_CD , RPRS_PET_YN , USE_YN , REG_DT , MDFCN_DT , MDFR_ID FROM BRUP_REL WHERE MBR_SN = #{mbrSn} AND PET_SN = #{petSn} AND USE_YN = 'Y'

/* 반려동물 양육자 목록 조회 */ SELECT R.BRUP_REL_SN , R.MBR_SN , M.MBR_NCNM , R.BRUP_ROLE_CD FROM BRUP_REL R JOIN MBR M ON M.MBR_SN = R.MBR_SN WHERE R.PET_SN = #{petSn} AND R.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY R.BRUP_ROLE_CD , R.REG_DT , R.BRUP_REL_SN
